purchases.title: A Lodging of Wayfaring Men
purchases.summary:
This novel was a major influence: first in the Cyber-underground and then in the larger world. "A Lodging of Wayfaring Men" is the story of ethical people who create an alternative society on the Internet – a virtual society, with no possibility of oversight or control. It grows so fast that governments and "leaders" are terrified, and fight to destroy it before it undermines the power of the ruling elite.

Read by nostr:npub1klkk3vrzme455yh9rl2jshq7rc8dpegj3ndf82c3ks2sk40dxt7qulx3vt (Max Hillebrand).
